bio.short: IT Instructor at University of Jaffna with expertise in software engineering, enterprise system architecture, and educational technology. Passionate about bridging academic excellence with industry-relevant technical solutions.
bio.long: Passionate educator and software engineer with extensive experience in building scalable enterprise systems and mentoring the next generation of technology professionals. As an IT Instructor at the University of Jaffna, I combine deep technical expertise in full-stack development with a commitment to innovative pedagogy. My work spans from architecting complex student information systems to delivering comprehensive courses in software engineering, database management, and web technologies. I specialize in creating robust, user-centric applications while fostering technical excellence in academic environments.
